title: Beyond Agent Architecture: Execution Assumptions and Reproducibility in LLM-Based Trading Systems
abstract: arXiv:2606.08285v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) and agentic systems are increasingly proposed for financial trading, yet their reported performance remains difficult to compare because studies vary in data provenance, temporal split discipline, execution timing, turnover treatment, and transaction-cost modeling. This article presents a targeted topical review and reproducibility audit of execution realism in LLM-based trading research. A coded evidence matrix covering 30 trade-relevant primary studies is used to assess point-in-time controls, split transparency, held-out evaluation, cost and turnover treatment, execution semantics, universe definition, and artifact release. Across the audited sample, architecture reporting is generally clearer than the evaluation assumptions needed to judge whether a trading result is economically interpretable or reproducible. A 10-equity worked example is included only as a methodological scaffold to illustrate

translated_title: 超越智能体架构：基于大语言模型交易系统中的执行假设与可复现性
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）和智能体系统日益被提议用于金融交易，但由于各研究在数据来源、时间切分规范、执行时点、换手率处理以及交易成本建模等方面存在差异，其报告的性能难以相互比较。本文对基于大语言模型的交易研究中的执行真实性进行了针对性专题综述与可复现性审计。通过一个覆盖30项交易相关一手研究的编码证据矩阵，评估了时点数据控制、切分透明度、留出集评估、成本与换手率处理、执行语义、股票池定义以及研究成果发布等维度。在受审计的样本中，架构方面的报告普遍比判断交易结果是否具有经济学可解释性或可复现性所需的评估假设更为清晰。文中包含一个10只股票的示例，仅作为方法论支架用来说明相关问题。
tldr: 本文对30项基于大语言模型的交易研究进行了可复现性审计，发现研究者在智能体架构上的报告普遍较为清晰，但判断交易结果是否经济上可解释、实验上可复现所必需的执行与评估假设（如交易成本、执行时点、时间切分等）的报告却明显不足。
en_tdlr: This topical review and reproducibility audit of 30 LLM-based trading studies finds that architecture reporting is generally clearer than the execution and evaluation assumptions—such as cost modeling and temporal splits—needed to judge whether reported trading results are economically interpretable or reproducible.
